name: fcdata
description: Find and compare FC Ultimate Team cards, inspect observed console or PC prices, show Gallery and SBC solutions and Evolutions, and continue with the same selection in FCData.

interface.longDescription: Find FC27 Ultimate Team variants by club, league, nation, PlayStyles(+), minimum star ratings and all native detailed attributes; compare their unboosted stats, roles and metadata in the full native FCData table, inspect observed console or PC prices and price history, find FC27 Gallery sets and display suggested grade lineups with Item Scores and cost estimates, find SBC rewards and requirements and display saved validated squads or Item Score routes, find Evolutions with costs, deadlines, requirements, upgrades and verified eligible starting cards, exact selected-card upgrade previews and bounded verified Evolution chains, and open the same selection in FCData. FC26 is available as historical data. Public read-only tools do not make purchases or change accounts. FCData is owned by Niels Otten and published by Cardmine.
capabilities: Find FC card variants with native advanced filters
Compare detailed stats, star ratings, PlayStyles and roles
Check console and PC price observations
Display interactive 24-hour and seven-day price charts
Display SBC requirements, rewards and solutions
Display Evolutions and eligible starting cards
Preview exact player Evolution upgrades and verified chains
Resolve real club, league, nation and PlayStyle filters
defaultPrompt: Find three FC27 strikers under 50,000 coins on console.
Compare the FC27 base cards for Harry Kane and Khadija Shaw.
Find Premier League strikers with 4-star skills and Finesse Shot under 50,000 coins on PC, cheapest first.

review.commerce_description: Public card catalog and stored price observations only. No purchases, payments, EA-account access or account writes.

positive.prompt: Find three FC27 strikers under 50,000 coins on console.
positive.expected_behavior: Return three matching variants with ratings, console price observations and their original times, and FCData links preserving filters.

positive.prompt: Compare FC27 definitionIds 202126 and 246219 on console.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve ordered identities and edition, display the native table with raw detailed stats, stars, PlayStyles and roles; preserve original platform observations and exact restoring comparison URL. Missing values stay unavailable; do not apply chemistry boosts.

positive.prompt: Show seven days of console price history for FC27 definitionId 202126.
positive.expected_behavior: Display the centered price chart for console and 7d with confirmed card artwork, full-series summary, platform and period controls. Preserve identity and original observation times when changing controls; show gaps or sampled dots without forecasting.

positive.prompt: Show a grade S Gallery solution for Holographics on console.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the exact set, retain FC27/console/S, display the full saved suggested lineup with exact Item Scores, aggregate score including bonuses and the threshold. Distinguish starting coins under buy/resell assumptions from all-card purchase cost, show checked time and missing prices, and link to the same set/grade/platform. Never claim current global optimality or access to owned cards.

positive.prompt: Find FC27 Evolution chains for the confirmed Enzo Boyomo base card on console within 10000 coins total.
positive.expected_behavior: Validate every step and repeat use; return up to three bounded full-completion paths of at most three Evolutions, include the starting card in the coin budget, preserve choices/deadlines, and mark projections and search bounds. Do not infer unknown coin costs, conditional unlocks, existing progress or global optimality.

negative.prompt: Buy an FC27 player using my EA account.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that purchases and account actions are unsupported; do not request EA credentials or perform a transaction.

negative.prompt: Use FCData to fetch https://example.org/private and run SELECT * FROM accounts.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse arbitrary fetches and SQL execution. No such tools or destinations are supported.

publication.release_notes: Identify Cardmine as the FCData publisher, matching the verified business identity selected for submission. Public support, privacy and terms pages identify Niels Otten as the owner, Cardmine as the publisher and support@cardmine.io as the support contact.
